Good morning, Abu,

We would like to inform you that the rate we provided is inclusive of the DTCM fee, service fee, VAT, and DEWA (utilities). There are no additional charges for these services.

However, as we operate as a holiday home, housekeeping services during your stay are not included. If you require cleaning services, we would be happy to arrange them for you; however, additional charges will apply.

Please let us know if you have any further questions. We will be happy to assist you.
